summary: DV6 is the largest and least-defined site of the contested Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone. Concerns mirror the zone-wide critiques (Green Belt loss, transparency, jobs composition, renewables deliverability) with the added scale of the South Lanridge farmland site and its associated large BESS.

principal_concerns.concern: Loss of Green Belt farmland south of the M8, on a site APRS assumes will host most of the zone's 500MW, plus a very large battery energy storage system

Cumulative impact with the adjacent ILI Aurelius data centre proposal (~0.9km away at North Lanrigg), proposed energy parks (up to 19 turbines to 200m, solar, BESS) and multiple other BESS/solar schemes already in the planning system around Chapelhall
Transparency of the AI Growth Zone's extent and of zone-level jobs and renewable-energy claims

claimed_local_benefits.benefit: Zone-level Community Investment Fund of up to £543m over 15 years and 3,400+ jobs (see datavita-dv4 economic_claims for full classification and the APRS FoI counter-claim)

stakeholder_positions.position: Opposed/critical of the AI Growth Zone development on the Green Belt; documents the DV6 PAN and calls for transparency

notes: STV reports the PAN was notified to MPs, MSPs and community councils with consultation events intended in April and June 2026 (APRS says April and May); whether they took place, and any community council responses, were not located.
